summary: Fixed qty-field accepts-clamped-barcode bug in Scanner app
root_cause: Three onChange handlers in ScanItems.jsx (inline row edit, mobile popup, desktop popup) silently clamped any value > MAX_MANUAL_QTY (99999) down to 99999. Because the value was clamped BEFORE state, the downstream rejection check (newQty > MAX_MANUAL_QTY) never triggered, and the clamped 99999 was committed as a legitimate quantity.
fix: Removed clamp from ScannedItemRow inline qty onChange (multi-SKU path)
Removed clamp from mobile Quantity Popup onChange
Removed clamp from desktop Quantity Popup onChange
Added visible error toast (setLastScanResult) in handleQuantityUpdate when newQty > MAX_MANUAL_QTY, in addition to existing invalid beep + state revert
expected_behavior: Scanning a barcode (>99999) into any qty input field plays invalid beep, shows error toast 'Invalid quantity — max allowed is 99999', reverts to the original quantity, and refocuses the barcode input.
next_actions: Manual on-device verification with a real handheld scanner recommended (mobile-only guard prevents desktop e2e).
